post_clip.description: At 03:18:12 PM (frame 9), a man in a pink shirt suddenly lunges and strikes a man in a green shirt who is seated on a motorcycle; the victim recoils and attempts to flee while the attacker pursues and continues striking him (frames 10–12). The victim does not fight back and appears to be cowering/escaping, consistent with a one-sided assault.

A one-sided assault occurs: a man in a pink shirt aggressively strikes another man (in light blue shirt) who is cowering and attempting to flee without fighting back. The attacker swings what appears to be a stick or rod, and the victim recoils and moves away while being pursued. Other bystanders react and move aside, indicating sudden violent escalation.

A man in a teal shirt aggressively approaches and strikes a person seated on a pink motorcycle (visible at 03:18:33–03:18:36), who appears to cower and does not fight back; the attacker then steps back while the victim remains seated and subdued, consistent with a one-sided assault.
